author: Шелестов Максим Евгеньевич
scope: Statistical implementation details supplement frozen study-plan v2. No maps, seeds, horizons, primary or exclusions changed. Written before selected six-NPC comparisons were analyzed.
unit: World/seed. Median NPC capital change inside each world is one observation.
signTest: Exact two-sided binomial sign test, zeros discarded from sign-test N only; zeros remain in medians and bootstrap.
multipleTesting: Holm step-down correction over four planned contrasts, including incomplete contrasts; no selected favorable comparisons.
censoring: Missing milestones are right-censored; conditional observed milestone distribution is explicitly separate. No zero or horizon imputation.
interpretation: Capital includes Core stock/asset valuation, distinct from paid operating receipts. An 1800-tick contrast cannot establish long-term Hard superiority or stage II-V balance.
